en.headline: Cheung Sha Wan menu archive show runs until 27 September
en.dek: After Taste, staged by studio artellex in an industrial building, displays historic menus, cookbooks and Mid-Autumn mooncake tins; entry is free by appointment.
body: A small exhibition of historic Hong Kong menus and Mid-Autumn bakery tools remains open in Cheung Sha Wan until 27 September, timed as the festival approaches on 25 September.

Local photography and print studio artellex, working with private collectors including John Wu of MODERNISM, has arranged the display as five "courses", from a 1902 hotel menu through handwritten restaurant cards, old cookbooks and mooncake tins and wooden moulds from shops such as Tak Yu, Tak Nam and Hang Heung. The organisers said they wanted visitors to read the city's dining history the way they would read a menu.

After Taste is at Room 204A, 2/F, Sun Cheong Industrial Building, 1-3 Cheung Shun Street, a short walk from Lai Chi Kok MTR Exit A. Hours are noon to 7pm, closed Mondays. Admission is free but the organisers ask visitors to book a slot in advance. No food is served.

zh.headline: 長沙灣《過去味來》展出百年餐牌 27日結束
zh.dek: 攝影工作室artellex在長順街工業大廈展出舊菜單、食譜及中秋月餅罐模，免費入場須預約，中秋前可看最後數天。
body: 以香港舊餐牌和中秋餅具為主題的展覽《過去味來》，展期至9月27日，中秋節前仍開放最後數天。
本地攝影及打印工作室artellex聯同包括MODERNISM胡兆昌在內的收藏家，將展品分成頭盤、前菜、主菜、甜品及餐後酒五部分，展出1902年酒店西餐牌、酒樓書法菜單、食譜古籍，以及德如、德南、恆香等老牌月餅鐵罐與木模。籌辦單位表示，希望參觀者像翻菜單一樣，一道一道看香港人怎樣吃。
展覽設於長沙灣長順街1至3號新昌工業大廈2樓204A室，鄰近荔枝角港鐵站A出口，中午12時至下午7時開放，逢星期一休息。免費入場，須先預約。場內不設飲食。
